sentences.text: This creature possessed long wings paired with short legs built for perching.
It likely acted as an opportunistic omnivore, eating whatever food sources were available.
Stephen Czerkas and Qiang Ji formally described the genus in 2002.
The authors established the family Omnivoropterygidae and the order Omnivoropterygiformes to house this genus.
Fossils from the Upper Jiufotang Formation in China date to the Early Cretaceous, specifically between 121.4 and 113.2 million years ago during the Aptian stage.
Some scientists argue that the family is invalid because it contains only a single genus, while others debate if the species is a junior synonym of Sapeornis and should be abandoned.
